recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not reintroduce Device.statusReason for this seed; any future operational or association reason modeling should be handled by a new work-group decision that accounts for the later DeviceAssociation and extension-pack changes.
issue_request: FHIR-28425 asked OO to resolve ambiguity in Device.statusReason, where some reason values related to the Device record and others to the physical or operational device. The Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution said the concern had been resolved by FHIR-26300.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-28425 was found. FHIR-26300, the issue cited by the seed resolution, is Resolved - No Change/Retracted. The substantive status split was instead applied through related Device work, especially FHIR-32557 and commit 0cd35c3c18, which removed Device.statusReason, made Device.status a Device record status, and added Device.availabilityStatus.
additional_context: Later Device status and operation/association decisions constrain the current interpretation. FHIR-34542 and later reconciliation keep Device.status record-oriented; FHIR-36213/37545 addressed the later Device operation/statusReason family; FHIR-38904 removed active Device.operation and Device.association status-reason content; FHIR-46962 corrected the Device status narrative to reference Device.status and availabilityStatus. Those related issues are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/fhir.ini keeps Device in the active build, source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml defines Device.status as record status and Device.availabilityStatus as device availability, and XML parsing found no active Device.statusReason path. Remaining statusReason text is only in commented-out historical blocks, so editing it would not improve the current build.
